entity.summary: Self-custody Ethereum and EVM wallet ecosystem from Rainbow Studio, distributed through mobile applications and a desktop browser extension.
entity.notes: Official Rainbow repository history records an external beta release and a production release during 2019 under the earlier Balance/Rainbow mobile lineage. WLR therefore records the Rainbow entity launch at 2019 year precision without asserting one exact initial App Store publication day.

products.summary: Rainbow self-custody mobile wallet for iOS and Android.
products.notes: Rainbow's official repository preserves the mobile wallet's earlier Balance Wallet release lineage. A 2019-02-05 commit explicitly records a beta external release and the exact README identifies the product as a mobile wallet focused on iOS; the repository then records a v1.0.0 Production Release on 2019-06-20. WLR records 2019 at year precision because the reviewed history establishes external/public release during 2019 but not one defensible exact first App Store release day. Earlier 2018 beta-release commits are not used because their external/public status is ambiguous.

products.summary: Rainbow desktop browser-extension wallet, supported across major Chromium browsers, Firefox, and Safari.
products.notes: Rainbow's official browser-extension repository shows Chrome Web Store and publishing preparation during 2022, but WLR does not treat those preparation commits as launch evidence. The repository explicitly enters a Production version-bump lineage in 2023, beginning with reviewed v1.0.75 production history on 2023-03-18, and Rainbow's own public updates site publishes extension release notes during 2023. WLR therefore records 2023 at year precision without asserting one exact first store-release day.

events.title: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 added signature-security hardening
events.description: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 deprecated support for dApps relying on the vulnerable eth_sign signing method and added sanitization of EIP-712 signature-request fields to mitigate common phishing attacks.
events.notes: This records a material security-hardening release, not a claim that a specific exploited Rainbow vulnerability existed.

events.title: Rainbow Extension v1.1.0 added Demonic mitigation
events.description: Rainbow Extension v1.1.0 redesigned the secret-recovery-phrase import flow to mitigate the known Demonic browser-wallet vulnerability reported by Halborn.
events.notes: The official Rainbow release establishes that v1.1.0 contained the mitigation. WLR does not infer an affected-version range, exploitation, realized loss, Rainbow-specific severity, or the extension launch date from this source.

events.title: Rainbow Mobile released externally in 2019
events.description: Rainbow's official mobile-wallet repository records an external beta release in February 2019 and a v1.0.0 production release in June 2019, establishing the public mobile release lineage during 2019.
events.notes: Year precision only. Earlier 2018 beta-release commits do not clearly establish an external/public boundary; neither the 2019 external-beta commit nor the later production-release commit is treated as proof of one exact initial App Store launch day.

events.title: Rainbow Browser Extension released in 2023
events.description: Rainbow's official extension repository records a production release lineage in 2023, and Rainbow's public release-notes site independently confirms the extension's public release lineage during that year.
events.notes: Year precision only. 2022 Chrome Web Store manifest and publish-workflow preparation are not treated as launch evidence; neither the first reviewed Production version bump nor a later public release-note date is asserted as the exact initial store launch day.

evidence.title: Rainbow Terms of Use
evidence.notes: Primary legal source identifies Rainbow Studio, Inc., mobile/extension services, and non-custodial device-local private keys.

evidence.title: Rainbow
evidence.notes: Current first-party page offers both Rainbow Mobile and Rainbow Extension.

evidence.title: Supported Browsers and Systems
evidence.notes: Current extension support includes Chrome, Brave, Edge, Arc, Firefox, Safari, and Chromium browsers on desktop.

evidence.title: Bridging and Testnets — Rainbow Extension v1.2.39
evidence.notes: Primary Rainbow release notes documenting eth_sign deprecation and EIP-712 field sanitization in v1.2.39.

evidence.title: Rainbow Extension v1.1.0
evidence.notes: Official Rainbow browser-extension release notes. The Security section states that the import flow was redesigned to mitigate the known Demonic vulnerability reported by Halborn.

evidence.title: Rainbow predecessor mobile wallet beta external release v0.3.0 (22)
evidence.notes: Official Rainbow repository history from the earlier Balance Wallet naming. The commit explicitly records a beta external release, adds release tag v0.3.0-22, increments the iOS CFBundleVersion, and bumps the wallet package version. Used to establish the 2019 external-release boundary, not an exact first App Store launch day.

evidence.title: Rainbow v1.0.0 (11) Production Release
evidence.notes: Official Rainbow repository commit explicitly marking v1.0.0 (11) Production Release. Used as first-party corroboration that the public mobile release lineage was established during 2019, not as proof that 2019-06-20 was the initial launch day.

evidence.title: Rainbow Browser Extension Production version bump v1.0.75
evidence.notes: Official Rainbow browser-extension repository commit explicitly marked Version Bump (Production) - v1.0.75. Used to establish the 2023 production-release lineage, not as proof of the exact first Chrome Web Store launch day.

evidence.title: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 — Bridging and Testnets
evidence.notes: First-party public Rainbow extension release notes during 2023. Used as independent first-party corroboration of the public release lineage in that year, not as the initial launch-day assertion.
